generalInfo.generalRule: Brookshire Grocery Arena guests are advised to arrive early and only bring necessary items to the event to expedite screenings. All patrons will be required to enter a security checkpoint for bag check and metal detection prior to entry. Patrons will be limited to small bags maximum 6 inches x 9 inches x 2 inches or smaller. Small Medical bags will be permitted, as well as clear bags 12 inches x 6 inches x 12 inches or smaller. All bags will be searched. Diaper bags, strollers, car seats, baby carriers, and backpacks are not allowed. There will also be an entrance that will provide faster entry for patrons with no bags at certain events. Please note that the following items are prohibited from being brought into this event: Bags larger than 6 inches x 9 inches, Video Cameras or Recording Devices, Backpacks, Diaper Bags, Baby Carriers, Strollers, Laser Pointers or Noise Makers, Weapons of any kind, Alcoholic Beverages, Illegal Drugs or Paraphernalia, Selfie Sticks, Lap Top Computers or Tablets, Coolers, Luggage of any kind or Camera Bags. Other items may be prohibited. * NO re entry.
generalInfo.childRule: Varies per show. For most shows if the child has celebrated their 2nd birthday they must have a ticket, unless otherwise specified.

events.info: Experience the power of love at Disney On Ice! Feel the excitement as Mickey, Minnie, Donald, and Goofy welcome you into two worlds filled with heart. First, journey to wintery Arendelle with Anna and Elsa, where the chill of the ice melts into the warmth of sisterly love. Then, sing and dance with Mirabel and the Familia Madrigal as the story of Encanto bursts to life in vibrant color all around you. Don't miss sharing a little joyful mischief with Stitch and Angel as they bring nonstop laughter to the ice. Come be part of the magic, music, and memories at Disney On Ice presents Magic of Family! *Note: Costumes not permitted for guests 14 years & older. Visit DisneyOnIce.com for more information.
